items.description: CONCLUSION: Pregnancy-, lactation- and reproductive potential-related eligibility criteria are common in cardiovascular trials. Many exclusions of pregnant or lactating women were not supported by drug-specific safety data, particularly for lactation. Continued exclusion in the absence of sufficient safety data limits opportunities to generate evidence within the controlled setting of clinical trials, shifting evidence generation to routine clinical practice.
items.conclusion: Pregnancy-, lactation- and reproductive potential-related eligibility criteria are common in cardiovascular trials. Many exclusions of pregnant or lactating women were not supported by drug-specific safety data, particularly for lactation
